press_references.value: QIB, Visa launch summer rewards campaign for new Marriott Bonvoy credit cardholders

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank launched a new summer rewards campaign in collaboration with Visa and Marriott International’s Marriott Bonvoy program for new co-branded credit cardholders. The campaign runs through October 24, 2026, and offers bonus loyalty points based on card usage.

press_references.value: QIB promotes healthy living on World No Tobacco Day 20216

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank partnered with Qatar Cancer Society to organize a Smoking Risks Awareness Day for employees as part of World No Tobacco Day 2026 activities, promoting healthy lifestyles and smoking cessation.

press_references.value: QIB launches exclusive FIFA World Cup 2026 experience, courtesy of Visa

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank and Visa announced a collaborative promotion offering QIB Visa cardholders chances to win exclusive FIFA World Cup 2026 experiences.

press_references.value: QIB launches the Life Continuity takaful plan

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank and Damaan Islamic Insurance Company (Beema) have entered an exclusive distribution partnership for the new Life Continuity Takaful Plan, which QIB offers through its mobile app.

press_references.value: QIB announces Mastercard “10 Million Loyalty Points” international spend campaign grand winners

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank highlighted its longstanding strategic partnership with Mastercard, which supports co-branded cards and reward campaigns such as the 2025 International Spend Campaign.

press_references.value: QIB first bank in Qatar to launch Click to Pay service for Mastercard cardholders

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank partnered with Mastercard to roll out Click to Pay in Qatar, making QIB the first bank in the country to offer the service to Mastercard cardholders with biometric authentication.

press_references.value: BNPL to make inroads; more banks open to tie up with fintechs

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank partnered with PayLater to offer Shariah-compliant BNPL services to customers and merchants in Qatar.

press_references.value: QIB and Visa launch cards summer spend campaign

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) and Visa have announced a new partnership to launch a summer spend campaign, offering exclusive rewards to QIB Visa cardholders for international spending.

press_references.value: QIB ties up with Umrah agencies to support Hajj pilgrims in Qatar

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) has announced a new partnership with several Hajj and Umrah agencies in Qatar to distribute Hajj guidelines books to pilgrims as part of its social responsibility initiatives.

press_references.value: QIB launches Visa+ to simplify international money transfers

partnership_announcements.description: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) has partnered with Visa to launch Visa+, a service that simplifies international money transfers for QIB customers. This partnership marks a significant step in transforming remittances and reshaping the money movement landscape in Qatar.

press_references.value: QIB collaborates with Qatar Airways Privilege Club

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank launched a limited-time bonus Avios campaign for its existing Qatar Airways co-branded Visa Signature and Platinum credit cards, offering up to 30,000 Avios to new cardholders meeting spend and salary-transfer criteria between June and August 2026.

press_references.value: QIB rewards new salaried customers with up to 125,000 Absher points

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank launched a limited-time salary transfer campaign rewarding new or returning salaried customers with up to 125,000 Absher rewards points and preferential financing when they transfer their salary and take selected credit cards.

press_references.value: ZAWYA-PRESSR: QIB simplifies account opening for workers through WPS portal & Lite app

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank enhanced its Wages Protection System portal and QIB Lite App to offer a fully digital, integrated journey for employers to open worker accounts and for workers to verify, activate, and access banking services.

press_references.value: QIB launches the Life Continuity takaful plan

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank launched and is exclusively distributing Beema’s new Life Continuity Takaful Plan, a term takaful product offering death and disability coverage plus related benefits via QIB’s mobile app.

press_references.value: QIB launches Qatar National Day 2025 salary transfer campaign

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank launched a limited-time salary transfer campaign tied to Qatar National Day 2025, offering Absher Rewards Points and a first-year free credit card to customers transferring their salaries to the bank.

press_references.value: QIB first bank in Qatar to launch Click to Pay service for Mastercard cardholders

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank launched Mastercard Click to Pay for its cardholders via the QIB Mobile App, becoming the first bank in Qatar to offer the biometric-enabled instant checkout service.

press_references.value: PRESSR: QIB expands its mobile app features to enhance customer experience

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) has launched several new features on its Mobile App and QIB Lite App, including Instant Credit Card for non-salaried customers, expanded Instant Cash Pickup service to Pakistan, and a Salary Advance feature for low-income earners, enhancing digital banking services and customer experience.

press_references.value: QIB launches the QIB Junior App, Qatar’s first figital banking experience for Kids and Teens

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) has officially launched the QIB Junior App, Qatar’s first digital banking and financial education platform for kids and teens aged 8 to 17. The app includes features like a prepaid Visa card, savings pot, parental controls, and rewards, aiming to build financial literacy and smart money habits among young users.

press_references.value: QIB launches Visa+ to simplify international money transfers

product_launches.description: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) has launched Visa+, a new service in partnership with Visa, to simplify international money transfers for its customers. This service allows QIB customers to send money to Visa cardholders in the GCC using a mobile number as an alias, enhancing security and convenience.

press_references.value: QIB, Al Meera launch new co-brand credit card

product_launches.description: A co-branded credit card offering Meera Rewards points, exclusive shopping benefits, and premium lifestyle privileges.

about_short_description.short_description: Qatar Islamic Bank is an Islamic financial institution that operates under the supervision of the Shari'a board.

product.name: Accounts
product.description: Sharia-compliant banking accounts, including current, savings, Misk and fixed-deposit accounts, for managing deposits and everyday finances.

product.name: Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing solutions for personal, property and other customer needs, including instant finance applications through the QIB Mobile App.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Business banking services for local and international companies, including transfers, trade finance applications, deposits, liquidity management, cheque services and SWIFT support.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Sharia-compliant credit cards that enable customers to make purchases and repay at least 5% of the outstanding amount monthly, subject to applicable terms.

product.name: QIB Mobile App
product.description: A 24/7 mobile banking application for managing accounts, checking finance status, controlling cards, making domestic and international transfers, and paying bills.

product.name: Aamaly
product.description: A business banking program for small and medium-sized enterprises that supports business growth and routine financial transactions.
